svg.aria-label: Diagram of the v1 two-tower network. Waveform tower: 8-lead ECG [B, 8, 2500] through three Conv1d blocks (8 to 32 kernel 7, 32 to 64 kernel 5, 64 to 128 kernel 3, each with BatchNorm, ReLU, MaxPool 2, Dropout 0.2) giving 32 by 1250, 64 by 625 and 128 by 312, then adaptive average pooling to a 128-d embedding. Tabular tower: Linear 64 and Linear 32 with BatchNorm, ReLU, Dropout 0.3 giving a 32-d embedding. Fusion head: concatenate to 160, Linear 64, Linear 16, Linear 1 with sigmoid giving P(CTRCD).
svg.title: v1 two-tower model

text.tspan: 1-D CNN · each block: Conv1d → BatchNorm → ReLU → MaxPool 2 → Dropout 0.2
MLP · each layer: Linear → BatchNorm → ReLU → Dropout 0.3

svg.text: Trained with BCE · class weights · stratified 5-fold CV
Augmentations: noise · shift · crop · time-warp · baseline wander · lead dropout
